title: Enhancing Large Language Model-Based Systems for End-to-End Circuit Analysis Problem Solving
abstract: arXiv:2512.10159v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLMs have shown strong performance in data-rich domains such as programming, but their reliability in engineering tasks remains limited. Circuit analysis is particularly challenging because it requires both multimodal understanding and precise mathematical reasoning. This paper presents an enhanced end-to-end circuit problem-solving framework using Gemini 2.5 Pro as the backbone model for scalable engineering-education applications. We systematically evaluate Gemini 2.5 Pro on undergraduate circuit-analysis problems and identify two major failure modes: circuit-recognition hallucinations, especially source-polarity errors, and reasoning-process hallucinations, such as incorrect current-direction assumptions. To reduce recognition errors, we integrate a fine-tuned YOLO detector with OpenCV-based processing to isolate voltage and current sources for polarity re-identification. translated_title: 增强基于大语言模型的端到端电路分析问题求解系统
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在编程等数据丰富的领域展现出强大的性能，但其在工程任务中的可靠性仍然有限。电路分析尤其具有挑战性，因为它既需要多模态理解能力，又需要精确的数学推理能力。本文提出了一个增强的端到端电路问题求解框架，以Gemini 2.5 Pro作为骨干模型，面向可扩展的工程教育应用。我们在本科电路分析问题上对Gemini 2.5 Pro进行了系统性评估，并识别出两种主要失效模式：电路识别幻觉（尤其是电源极性错误）和推理过程幻觉（例如错误的电流方向假设）。为了减少识别错误，我们集成了微调的YOLO检测器与基于OpenCV的处理方法，以分离出电压源和电流源进行极性重新识别。为了缓解推理错误，我们引入了ngspice（电路仿真验证）机制。
tldr: 该论文提出以Gemini 2.5 Pro为骨干的端到端电路分析求解框架，通过微调YOLO检测器结合OpenCV进行电源极性重识别以消除识别幻觉，并引入ngspice电路仿真验证来纠正推理幻觉，显著提升了大模型解决电路问题的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an enhanced end-to-end circuit analysis framework based on Gemini 2.5 Pro, which eliminates recognition hallucinations via a fine-tuned YOLO detector with OpenCV for source polarity re-identification and mitigates reasoning errors through ngspice simulation verification, significantly improving LLM reliability in solving circuit problems.
